_doc: Maximum building envelope for neighbouring lots (מגורים א', טיפוס A) per TAMAL/1016 §4.1.2. Used by tools/derive_site.py.

maxHeightAboveEntrance_m.why: TAMAL/1016 limits floors (2) but gives no height in metres; no height found in the B1 development documents either. Avihai: use 8.00 m (neighbours will not exceed 6–7 m above their ground) – conservative envelope.

entranceLevel.rule: planned ±0.00 per lot from the development plan sheet 04 (symbol "מפלס כניסה קובעת")
entranceLevel.source: sources/neighborhood/development-B1/תכנית בינוי גיליון 04 מתחם B1.pdf (סרוק; פירוט ב-docs/sources-inventory/neighborhood.md)
